The '''''Last Chance''''' was a [[Sentinel-class landing craft|''Sentinel''-class shuttle]] that belonged to the [[Weequay]] [[pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka]],<ref name="Databank" /> after he [[Mission to Reklam Station|stole]] it from [[Reklam Station]], a secret [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Salvage yard|reclamation plant]] located on the [[planet]] [[Yarma]].<ref name="Steps" />
